archetype: Organic & Earthy (1) with High-End Editorial Elegance

brand_identity.vibe: intelligent trip design, elegance, trust, discovery, calm luxury

scale.h1: font-serif text-5xl md:text-6xl lg:text-7xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-medium text-[#1C1B1A]
scale.h2: font-serif text-4xl md:text-5xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-medium text-[#1C1B1A]
scale.h3: font-serif text-2xl md:text-3xl tracking-tight leading-snug font-medium text-[#1C1B1A]
scale.body: font-sans text-base md:text-lg leading-relaxed text-[#4A4846] font-light
scale.label: font-sans text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-medium text-[#7A7671]

layout.spacing: Generous and breathable. Use Tailwind classes like p-8, p-12, p-16, gap-12.

hero.style: Immersive editorial layout. Massive Serif H1, subtle background texture, and floating 'Example Trip' bento cards overlapping the bottom edge of the hero to invite scrolling.
hero.background: Use the sand texture background with a soft radial gradient overlay of sand (#D9C5B2) and pale terracotta (#F4DCD5) at 20% opacity. Add CSS noise/grain if possible.

cards.style: Large border-radius (3xl), 1px solid border (#E6E4DF), white background (#FFFFFF) or off-white (#FAF9F6). Internal padding must be generous (p-8 minimum).
cards.image_treatment: Images inside cards must have an inner 4px white or off-white border to look like framed editorial art/photos.

inputs.style: Tall inputs (h-14), rounded-2xl, background #FFFFFF, border #E6E4DF, focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#D36B4A]/30 focus:border-[#D36B4A] transition-all duration-300.

buttons.primary: bg-[#D36B4A] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-[0_8px_20px_rgb(211,107,74,0.2)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F0EFEB] text-[#1C1B1A] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-medium hover:bg-[#E6E4DF] transition-all duration-300

markdown_results.style: Styled like a high-end travel brief. Serif headings for days/locations. Left border accent in terracotta (#D36B4A) for key highlights/tips. Generous line height. Do not use generic standard markdown styling.
markdown_results.loader: Elegant cycling text animation ('Curating destinations...', 'Consulting local guides...', 'Finalizing your itinerary...') over a soft glowing background. Do not use a spinner.

motion.entrances: Staggered fade-up (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> 1) over 0.6s with ease-out cubic-bezier.

hero_background.description: Abstract subtle sand dune texture, light warm ivory and beige colors for global background

hero_image.description: Mediterranean villa at sunset for main hero visual

sample_trip_1.description: Amalfi Coast - Use for Sample Trip Card 1

sample_trip_2.description: Kyoto Autumn Temple - Use for Sample Trip Card 2

sample_trip_3.description: Sahara desert dunes - Use for Sample Trip Card 3

instructions_to_main_agent: Inject the google fonts in the main HTML file: Cormorant Garamond and Outfit.
Extend Tailwind configuration with the custom colors defined in this file. Add font-serif for Cormorant Garamond and font-sans for Outfit.

Use pure HTML+Tailwind for the layout structure. Use Shadcn components strictly for logic (Form, Input, DatePicker, Textarea). heavily customize Shadcn default styles to match the border-radius and colors here.
Make sure all interactive elements (buttons, inputs) and key informational elements have 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-trip-btn').
Do NOT use 'Inter' anywhere. The vibe must remain extremely editorial, like a high-end physical travel magazine.
Implement the Mock backend for POST /api/v1/plan-trip to return a nicely formatted markdown itinerary.
In the results panel, apply Tailwind Typography (prose) customized to match the editorial styling (Serif headings, sans body).
Instead of a standard spinner during generation, create a sophisticated loading state that cycles text as specified.
